I am running `FuzzDecodeShapeIndex` for 3 seconds to fuzz-test `ShapeIndex.Decode`.
I have implemented serialization and deserialization (`Encode` and `Decode`) on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L588-L637) and committed all changes to the `shapeindex-serialization` branch.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`ShapeIndex.Encode` and `ShapeIndex.Decode` ([shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go))**:
   - Added [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L1868-L1943) and [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L1948-L2146):
     - Calls [`Build`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L804-L806) before encoding so indexes that have not been explicitly built (or have pending updates) serialize with their full spatial cell structure.
     - Serializes `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, all active shapes alongside their assigned shape IDs, and the complete spatial index cell hierarchy (`cells`, `cellMap`, [`ShapeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L114-L116), and [`clippedShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L79-L91) entries), followed by a CRC32-IEEE checksum.
     - Restores the index in `fresh` status on [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L1948-L2146) so queries and iterators work immediately without calling `Build`.
   - Fixed [`applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L859-L893) and [`makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L1219-L1288) to use `s.nextID` rather than `len(s.shapes)` and handle shape removals cleanly so gaps in shape IDs preserve all surviving shapes and cell references.

2. **Built-in `Shape` Round-Tripping & Hardened Decoding**:
   - Added `Encode`/`Decode` and internal encoder/decoder support for [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/point_vector.go#L106-L157), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/lax_polyline.go#L118-L169), [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/lax_loop.go#L122-L175), and [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/lax_polygon.go#L222-L301), alongside [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/polygon.go#L1035-L1225), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/polyline.go#L417-L473), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/loop.go#L1255-L1323), and custom [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) implementations via [`genericShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go#L1629-L1658).
   - Fixed chain methods in [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/point_vector.go#L72-L74), [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/lax_loop.go#L88-L94), and [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/lax_polygon.go#L194-L214), and fixed value-receiver error loss in [`Polyline.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/polyline.go#L434-L473).
   - Hardened decoding in [`encode.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/encode.go), [`rect.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/rect.go), [`pointcompression.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/pointcompression.go), [`loop.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/loop.go), [`polygon.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/polygon.go), and [`shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex.go) with incremental slice allocation, bounds checks, finite float64 validation, and checksum verification so truncated, corrupted, or oversized inputs return errors without panicking.

3. **Tests ([shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o6sdj0e1/s2/shapeindex_test.go))**:
   - Added unit and fuzz tests covering empty indexes, all built-in `Shape` types, surviving shape IDs after removals, unbuilt indexes, spatial cell preservation and queries without `Build`, zero-edge shapes and mixed chain counts, and malformed inputs.
